params.block_definition: disjoint half-open intervals (x_j, x_{j+1}] tiling (x_0, x_last]; every prime used exactly once
params.count_definition: c_j = pi(x_{j+1}) - pi(x_j), exact integer via np.searchsorted(primes, x, side='right')
params.smooth_definition: L_j = R(x_{j+1}) - R(x_j), R = Riemann's function sum_n mu(n)/n li(x^(1/n)), differenced in mpf at the recorded dps, cast to float afterwards
params.smooth_diagnostic_definition: D_j = (li(x_{j+1}) - li(x_j)) - (R(x_{j+1}) - R(x_j)); normalised D_j / sqrt(x_j). Both smooth models are computed every run regardless of --smooth
params.theta_scan_definition: e_j / x_j^theta over a FIXED list of theta; half-ladder RMS ratio reported per theta. A parameter-free scan, NOT a fit — no theta is selected by the script
params.projection_definition: P(gamma) = |sum_j w_j * ehat_j * exp(-i gamma log x_j)|, w = hann; inner product, not a fit
params.precision: mixed: EXACT integer prime counts (numpy int64 array + binary search); mpmath li at mp.dps = 30 with the difference taken in mpf; float64 residual, theta scan and projection

constants.core_quantity_note: e = c - (li(upper) - li(lower)) is the project's core residual; CONTEXT.md defines e(r) as that quantity on the dyadic ladder, which is this script at x0 = 2, ratio = 2
constants.disjointness_note: O12-O15 summed primes[N:2N] indexed by PRIME INDEX: consecutive rungs overlapped (~90% shared primes at ratio 1.1) and the count was fixed at N by construction, so the count carried no fluctuation. Here the blocks are disjoint in VALUE space and the count fluctuates
constants.sampling_note: log x steps by log(r), so the projection Nyquist is pi/log(r); at r = 1.1 that is 32.96, clearing gamma_1..gamma_3
constants.band_rule: DETECT: global max of P within the band half-width of one of gamma_1..gamma_6 AND > 5x median(P); WEAK: a local peak within the band of one of the six > 5x median(P) but the global max is elsewhere; NULL: neither
constants.band_halfwidth_rule: max(0.6, one frequency resolution element). Deliberate: in O15 the pre-registered half-width 0.5 was NARROWER than one resolution element (0.605) so the band could barely fire. The band here is at least one resolution element wide by construction
constants.one_verdict_note: this instrument has no sigma and no t — it works on the raw count residual — so there is ONE verdict per (x0, ratio, xmax) setting
constants.o10_note: O10 is a deliberate gap in the series and is not filled by this script

smooth_difference_stats.definition: D_j = (li(x_{j+1}) - li(x_j)) - (R(x_{j+1}) - R(x_j)); normalised form D_j / sqrt(x_j)

gate_b.statement: at x0 = 2, ratio = 2.0, c_j == N(r) = pi(2^r) - pi(2^(r-1)) from pi2n_cache.json
gate_b.note: not applicable: --ratio 1.1 is not 2.0, so this ladder is not the dyadic one

gate_c.statement: li(10^6) against the known 78627.549..., and pi(10^6) = 78498 from the sieve
